ValidationRule.description: The Pending Reason 'Customer Response' needs to be selected for Status 'Customer - On Hold' The epic for reference #1008. The rule updated for CAC Executive Escalations record type. For ref, check user story #27296 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR($RecordType.Name = 'Global Service Case',$RecordType.Name = 'CAC Executive Escalations'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(NAS_Pending_Reason__c, 'Customer Response')), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Customer - On Hold') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Pending Reason should be 'Customer Response' to change the status to 'Customer - On Hold'.
